name: Nahid Islam
contribution: A leading coordinator of Students Against Discrimination, he became one of the public faces of the 2024 quota-reform protests and later served as an adviser in the interim government formed in August 2024.
context: Dhaka University-linked student coordination; July-August 2024 protest phase and post-uprising transition.
impact: His leadership linked street mobilization with the political transition after 5 August 2024.
highlight: From protest coordination to state transition, he became one of the movement’s central public figures.
